column1: # App partition offsets are left blank so the ESP-IDF partition table
# generator auto-aligns them to 64KB (see README.md for why) -- the exact
# resulting offsets are printed by `idf.py build` / `idf.py partition-table`.
# No optional "storage" nvs partition here (see partitions.csv) to save space.
# IMPORTANT: factory here (0xa0000 = 640KB) is NOT big enough for the
# network features. Measured against the real espressif/idf:release-v5.5
# image: even OTA+version-check+remote-HTTP alone (no BLE) already needs
# ~0x110000 (~1.06MB); adding BLE remote control pushes it to ~1.25MB (see
# partitions.csv's comment). A 4MB module has far less room to grow factory
# without eating into the app slot budget than the 8MB table does -- there
# is no one-size-fits-all default here
